column1: # Pinned classification databases for the prior-study Kraken2 reanalysis.
# This file is the single authoritative record of what the `kraken2_q1` and
# `kraken2_q10` rows in prior_studies.tsv were classified against. It is read by
# comparison/fetch_kraken2_db.sh, which downloads and verifies every entry, and
# by comparison/run_kraken2_reanalysis.sh, which points the workflow at the
# verified local copies rather than letting it resolve the URLs itself.
# Why these exact URLs: epi2me-labs/wf-metagenomics v2.14.1 hard-codes them in
# its `database_sets` map under the key `PlusPF-8`. Selecting
# `--database_set PlusPF-8` on that revision resolves to precisely these two
# files, so the pin below records what the reanalysis actually used rather than
# a plausible substitute. Verified on 2026-07-25 against
# https://raw.githubusercontent.com/epi2me-labs/wf-metagenomics/v2.14.1/nextflow.config
# (tag v2.14.1 = commit d8f780d9e03daee7cd3251c8928ddbcde7b3793e).
# Both URLs are dated and immutable. Note in particular that the *undated* NCBI
# path (pub/taxonomy/new_taxdump/new_taxdump.zip) is a rolling file rewritten
# daily and must never be substituted here; only the dated copy under
# taxdump_archive/ is reproducible.
# Columns
#   key           stable identifier used by the scripts
#   role          database | taxonomy
#   url           immutable download URL
#   bytes         exact Content-Length, checked before hashing
#   md5           MD5 of the downloaded file
#   sha256        SHA-256 where we computed one, "-" otherwise
#   checksum_src  where the checksum came from, so a reader can re-derive it
#   note          what the file is and what depends on it
key
kraken2_pluspf8
column7: Published upstream at https://genome-idx.s3.amazonaws.com/kraken/pluspf_08gb_20241228/pluspf08gb.md5, entry "k2_pluspf08gb_20241228.tar.gz" (the archive is served under a slightly different basename than the checksum file names it). Not independently recomputed here; fetch_kraken2_db.sh recomputes it on download.
column8: Kraken2 PlusPF capped at 8 GB, 2024-12-28 build. k=35, l=31, 51472 taxonomy nodes, table capacity 2000000000 (from the accompanying inspect.txt). The tarball ships its own nodes.dmp, names.dmp and ktaxonomy.tsv, so k-mer assignment does not consult the taxdump below.

column1: ncbi_taxdump
column7: Computed locally on 2026-07-25 from a complete download whose size matched Content-Length and whose CRCs all verified; NCBI publishes no .md5 sidecar for archived taxdumps.
column8: NCBI new_taxdump snapshot of 2025-01-01 (17 members, names.dmp 237704544 B, nodes.dmp 247648029 B). wf-metagenomics uses it for lineage lookup and abundance-table rollup, not for the k-mer assignment itself.
